params.body:
Beheer > Werking counts eleven photo rows without a file and names `stocklist:photos-without-file` as the next step. Running it on production answers:

```
No photo rows without a file.
```

Nil rows, while the screen keeps counting eleven. I wrote that line an hour earlier the same day and did not check that the command could reach the rows standing next to it.

## Two different sets

The command matches rows with an **empty path** and `processing = 0`: what the partner API left behind until 18 September when the download at the partner failed.

The eleven on production are the other case. They carry a name, the file never arrived in the bucket, and `processing` is still 1 from a job that gave up. That is exactly what R S1-6.36 has made impossible since 18 September, but the rows from before it (February through August, all of them platform copies) are still there.

A next step that does nothing is worse than no next step: you run it, you read "nil rows", and after that you stop believing the number beside it.

## The second pass

`--check-bucket` asks the same question of the bucket, one HEAD per row (`fileExists`, R S1-6.38, so it is not a directory listing). Three things keep it safe:

- it requires `--older-than`, because a row of a few minutes may still have its file on the way;
- a bucket that does not answer counts as "file present", so doubt never leads to deleting;
- the delete runs on the ids just judged, not on the query again — in this pass the query is the candidate list, not the result, and confusing the two would wipe every row that does have a file.

The line in the fold now names the full command.

## Verified

`TheCleanUpReachesTheRowsItNamesTest`: a row with a path and no file is reached, a row whose file is there survives, a fresh row is left alone, and the pass refuses without an age.

190 tests and 1.202 assertions across the rule catalogue, the photo commands and the operations screen; `phpstan` green over the whole project; `pint` green on the added file.

Fixes bevinding het-opruimcommando-raakte-de-rijen-niet.
params.title: The clean-up reaches the rows the screen points it at
